name: Jidai Matsuri procession paid seats
intro: The Jidai Matsuri is a procession on October 22 of people dressed in the costumes of over a thousand years of Japanese history. Paid seats along the route give you a reserved view, and the best seats sell out.

facts.location: Kyoto Gyoen and Oike-dori Street, Kyoto
facts.bookAhead: About six weeks: 2026 seats went on sale on September 8

statusNote: The 2026 sale date is from the Kyoto City Tourism Association's official site. The 2027 date is not announced yet; we show early September as a guide.
popularityNote: Not in our keyword data. Estimate: a smaller Kyoto festival than the Gion Matsuri.
difficultyNote: Official sales page: by October 17, 2026, all seats except Oike-dori general seats had sold out (sale began September 8).
bookingSteps: Check the official seat page for the sale date and which seats are left.
At 10:00 Japan time on sale day, buy online through the link on the official page, or at a Seven-Eleven in Japan.
Choose seats in the Kyoto Gyoen National Garden (with live commentary in English or Chinese) or on Oike-dori Street (guidebook, no commentary).
For Gyoen seats, bring your own smartphone with internet access and headphones. No app or account is needed.
Bring a raincoat. Umbrellas, parasols and tripods aren't allowed in the seats.
visitorTips: On October 17, 2026, only general seats on Oike-dori Street were still on sale for the 2026 procession.
After a natural disaster, the schedule and route may change or the festival may be cancelled.
The 2027 sale date has not been announced. We will update this page when it is.

soldOut.label: Watch from the street for free along the route

faq.q: When do Jidai Matsuri seats go on sale?
faq.a: In 2026 they went on sale at 10:00 Japan time on September 8. The 2027 date has not been announced yet.
